title: Audiologist and Speech Pathologist — Minimum Requirements
sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
notes: Section opens with a cross-reference: 'Other requirements are as stated under "Minimum requirements for all types of Health Institutions"' (page 67), repeated on page 68 with '(Appendix I)' — refer to the common all-institutions module; not extracted as items. Context passage (page 67), not an inspectable requirement: 'Speech therapists can do home visits and can work in the following places: Schools, Preschools, Hospitals, Rehabilitation centres, Private practice.'

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
items.requirement: A door that closes and ensures privacy.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
items.requirement: Access to either a basin or hand sanitizer (can use one nearby).
items.alternatives: Basin or hand sanitizer; may use one nearby.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
items.requirement: Adequate ventilation and lighting provided by both natural and artificial means.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
items.requirement: Should also have disability friendly ramps.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
items.requirement: Wide entrance that allows free movement of a wheel chair.

items.sourceHeading: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS – AUDIOLOGIST AND SPEECH PATHOLOGIST
items.requirement: Should be on the ground floor unless there is an elevator at the premises.
items.alternatives: Upper floor permitted where there is an elevator at the premises.
